_note: ROBOT-OWNED FILE. .github/workflows/youtube-sync.yml writes this every six hours; anything you type here can be reordered or overwritten. It is a staging tray, not site content — nothing in it is rendered. js/transmissions.js never reads this file.
_howToPublish: Take an object out of `pending`, write its `body`, set `id` to the next log number, drop it at the TOP of `entries` in data/transmissions.json (newest first — that file does not sort itself), then delete it from `pending` here and commit. Keys beginning with _ are notes for you and must NOT be copied across. Note that a row with an empty body renders as 'Title — ' with a trailing dash, so body is required in practice even though nothing enforces it.
_cutoffNote: The nine videos already on the channel were bulk-uploaded on 2025-06-11 and belong to an earlier album — they are deliberately excluded so the Channel Terminal stays a record of NEW activity rather than opening with nine identical timestamps. Two things keep them out: this cutoff date, and their ids being pre-listed in `seen`. To backfill them you would have to move the cutoff back AND remove their ids from `seen`. Remember YouTube's feed only ever returns the latest 15 videos, so anything older than that can never be recovered here and must be hand-written.
_seenNote: Every video id this job has ever surfaced. Its purpose is that a video you looked at and decided not to publish stays gone instead of reappearing every six hours. The job also treats anything already linked from data/transmissions.json as seen, so publishing an entry is enough on its own.
